papers.title: Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC): Universal Retrieval-Aware Ingestion of Enterprise Documents via PDF Normalization and Multimodal Markdown Conversion
papers.desc: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems over enterprise knowledge bases must ingest heterogeneous document formats -- PDFs, Word documents, presentations, and scans -- whose content is locked inside complex visual layouts, multi-column pages, and dense tables.

papers.title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
papers.desc: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions.

papers.title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
papers.desc: Natural interaction in digital and physical environments requires continuous perception and timely responses.

papers.title: CARE: Experience-Guided Atomic Corrective Execution for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.desc: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain brittle once execution deviates from nominal trajectories.

papers.title: Streaming Video Editing with Easy Adaptation
papers.desc: In this paper, we propose SVEET, a framework that requires merely training on a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model but supports high-quality streaming video editing in an auto-regressive fashion.

papers.title: The Functionalizer: Lossless Functional Decomposition for Subword Tokenization
papers.desc: Standard subword tokenizers either treat every orthographic variation of a word (such as hello, Hello, HELLO, and Héllo) as unrelated vocabulary entries, which fragments the embedding space, or discard this variation through lossy normalization.

papers.title: Complex KDA: Understanding and Enhancing the Expressivity of Kimi Delta Attention
papers.desc: Linear RNNs based on the delta-rule enable efficient sequence modeling, but their linear updates with a low-rank correction constrain their expressivity.

papers.title: Mira-Scene: Pixel-Aligned Layouts for Generative 3D Scene
papers.desc: Single-image 3D object generation can now produce high-fidelity assets, yet accurately placing them into a coherent scene layout remains an open challenge.

papers.title: SkillSpec: Intent-Masked Specification Reasoning for Agent Skill Correctness
papers.desc: Autonomous agent systems increasingly depend on reusable skill abstractions for consolidating experiential knowledge and domain expertise.

papers.title: A Lie Detector Test for Language Models: Reading Knowledge a Model Won't Reveal
papers.desc: Large language models can hold knowledge they do not report.

papers.title: TAPe+ML: A Compact Structured Representation for Multi-Task Computer Vision
papers.desc: We present TAPe+ML v3, a compact computer vision system based on TAPe (Theory of Active Perception), a structured representation that encodes relations among perceptual elements before recognition.

papers.title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
papers.desc: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications.

papers.title: ShieldVLA: Feasibility-Aware Safety Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong generalization in robotic manipulation and navigation, but existing fine-tuning methods provide limited safety guarantees.

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Smoothing and Validation for Disaggregated AI Evaluation
papers.desc: Evaluating an AI system requires disaggregated assessment, as performance varies across domains such as benchmark task types or conversation types in deployed agents.

papers.title: UltraTex: Unleashing 2K Multi-View Diffusion for 3D Texturing
papers.desc: High-quality texture generation is essential for creating realistic and production-ready 3D assets.
